scope: Device-free end-to-end audio check (tools/check_audio_e2e.py): SAPI Japanese speech paced in real time through MicSession/SpeakerSession -> recorder -> listener/VAD -> AudioTranscriber -> providers. Whisper real (weights base); Google via fake urlopen; OpenAI-compatible via local server.

findings.D1_record_timeout_drop: energy mode: the wall-clock record_timeout (3 s) races the audio-time phrase_time_limit (3 s); when it wins, the in-progress phrase (up to 3 s) is discarded. Present identically in the pinned SpeechRecognition fork (develop) and the Rust port.
findings.D2_short_continuation_rejected: energy mode: after a time-limit split, a remainder below phrase_threshold is rejected as too short and the word ending is lost. Identical in fork and port.
findings.fix: native/vrct-audio/src/energy.rs: record_timeout emits the buffered phrase via the normal acceptance path; a phrase starting within pause_threshold after a split is not rejected as short. Intended deviation from the fork: a short sound within 0.8 s after a split is now emitted.

ab_fork_vs_native_before_fix.note: pre-revision harness (always-available fake source). Speaker queued sizes identical between fork and native; mic drops random in both.

physical_hotplug.note: user-run tools/check_audio_capture.py hotplug, energy recorder, USB mic; device names not saved

before_fix.scope: Guided physical hotplug check of the production recorder classes; raw PCM discarded immediately, no ASR/network
limitations: Recorder layer only: MicSession/SpeakerSession, controller error notices and restarts are not run.
With Auto Mic Select on, the app follows the OS default input: DeviceManager monitoring stops the mic session, re-resolves the new default by name and restarts it. This tool never re-selects.
Auto Speaker Select also follows the active render endpoint (ActiveEndpointTracker); not run here.
error_after_enter_ms includes human delay before unplugging; last_data_to_error_ms does not.
outcome no_data means no read returned during the window; it says nothing about loudness.
Device names are printed to the console only and not saved.

after_fix.scope: Guided physical hotplug check of the production recorder classes; raw PCM discarded immediately, no ASR/network
limitations: Recorder layer only: MicSession/SpeakerSession, controller error notices and restarts are not run.
With Auto Mic Select on, the app follows the OS default input: DeviceManager monitoring stops the mic session, re-resolves the new default by name and restarts it. This tool never re-selects.
Auto Speaker Select also follows the active render endpoint (ActiveEndpointTracker); not run here.
error_after_enter_ms includes human delay before unplugging (negative if unplugged before Enter); last_data_to_error_ms does not.
outcome no_data means no read returned during the window; it says nothing about loudness.
